rows.english: Red dot means take cover.
They're almost out of time.
I got the ankh.
But we're teaming up now, right?
rows.turkish: Ama şimdi takım oluyoruz, değil mi?

rows.english: Keep moving! Kingpin can not win!
rows.turkish: Hareket etmeye devam edin! Kingpin kazanamaz!

rows.english: Obscure them from sight…
You thought I'd let you win? Nah.
rows.turkish: Kazanmana izin veririm mi sandın? Yanıldın.

rows.english: We best get out of here.
Ankh is gone.
That makes two of us, lil' sis.
rows.turkish: O zaman ikimiz de aynıyız, küçük kız kardeşim.

rows.english: Headed into the darkness. Just like always.
rows.turkish: Her zaman olduğu gibi yolumuz karanlığa çıkıyor.

rows.english: Get the nest!
Ain't no darkness can swallow me, I can do this!
rows.turkish: Hiçbir karanlık beni yutamaz, bunu yapabilirim!

rows.english: Right on!
Any backup out there?
Who are you? Really?
Just chill, ya'll.
Yo, eyes on your back!
No quittin'. We got friends in lockdown countin' on us.
rows.turkish: Pes etmek yok. Karantinada kilit altında olan arkadaşlarımız bize güveniyor.

rows.english: This place has some mad darkness bubblin' under its surface…
rows.turkish: Bu yerin yüzeyinin altında çılgın bir karanlık kaynıyor...

rows.english: Loki can't get more sap. It's that simple.
rows.turkish: Loki daha fazla öz suyu çalmamalı. Bu kadar basit.

rows.english: He heard a lot of people. I'm glad he's gone.
Hang in there, Tyrone.
Sniper. Watch your heads.
Hey man. Keep expectations low and you won't be disappointed.
rows.turkish: Birader, beklentilerini yüksek tutmazsan asla hayal kırıklığına uğramazsın.

rows.english: It's too bad you have to come back here so soon after escaping.
rows.turkish: Daha yeni kurtulmuşken buraya dönmek zorunda kalmana üzüldüm.

rows.english: Lock in on this enemy.
Yeah! Punisher's on the run again.
rows.turkish: İşte böyle! Punisher yine yayan kaldı.

rows.english: Darkforce is building…
Enemy was here!
Capture this area!
Sounds fun. But you're gonna have to run it past Dagger first. We're a package deal.
rows.turkish: Kulağa eğlenceli geliyor ama önce Dagger’dan onay alman gerekecek. İkimiz ayrılmayız.

rows.english: Robot spiders everywhere!
Can't handle that many bad guys.
I mean, he might do the job, but he's a broken man.
rows.turkish: Yani iş görebilir ama o arızalı bir adam.

rows.english: Even here, the dark follows.
She's not the jealous type. Besides we've got mad respect for what you do for the Lower East Side!
rows.turkish: O kıskanç tiplerden değil. Hem Lower East Side için yaptıklarına büyük saygı duyuyoruz!

rows.english: One wearer to another, Strange: You got serious cloak game.
rows.turkish: Pelerin kardeşi sayılırız diye diyorum Strange: Pelerin işinde bir numarasın.

rows.english: Us against the world!
Here's where we should defend.
Come to us. Dagger can heal you.
Not ready yet.
Moon sure seems to power him up.
That is one hurting tree. We gotta step it up.
It's always been me and Tandy against the world.
rows.turkish: Olduk olası dünyaya karşı Tandy'yle ikimiz olmuşuzdur.

rows.english: Thought you could walk on air?
Nope. Do not like the energy here.
rows.turkish: Yok. Buradaki enerji hiç hoşuma gitmedi.

rows.english: Whoo, three!
I pinged an enemy. Get em!
Tandy, I'm almost ready.
Your blade cuts clean, Magik!
Well, spider webs are supposed to be pretty strong.
rows.turkish: Hımm, örümcek ağları epey güçlü oluyor diye duymuştum.

rows.english: Lot of stuff you could smash around here.
I consume it to contain forces that would otherwise consume us all.
rows.turkish: Bunu, yoksa hepimizi yutacak güçleri dizginlemek için içime alıyorum.

rows.english: I'm too much!
Next stop: Underground.
We gotta shut Ultron down for good!
Please, we're hurt…
Nice to see Avengers Tower is still a beacon of light…
rows.turkish: Yenilmezler Kulesi’nin hâlâ parıl parıl parladığını görmek güzel…

rows.english: Magik, so your portals take you to another dimension too, yeah? Does it, like, hurt or anything like that?
rows.turkish: Magik, demek portalların seni de başka bir boyuta götürüyor. Canın acımıyor mu peki ya da ona benzer bir şeyler olmuyor mu hiç?

rows.english: Got this covered!
Welcome to the darkforce dimension!
Don't mind if I do.
Let's pop back up under their noses.
Yo. Save a tree.
Dagger would not like these sea creatures one bit…
rows.turkish: Dagger görse bu deniz yaratıklarını hiç sevmezdi…

rows.english: Move this turtle faster!
rows.turkish: Şu kaplumbağayı daha hızlı hareket ettirin!

rows.english: Public Eye, huh? Watching the public, but who do they serve?
rows.turkish: Kamusal Göz demek. Kamuyu gözetliyorlar, peki kimin için?

rows.english: Do you think the world is ever gonna be put right?
We can make it to the Tower! Keep pushin'!
Go easy on him, Ty. We can use all the light we can get right now.
rows.turkish: Üzerine fazla gitme Ty. Şu an kimsenin ışığını geri çeviremeyiz.

rows.english: You know what? That's exactly what I needed to hear.
rows.turkish: Bir şey diyeyim mi? Tam da bunu duymam gerekiyordu.

rows.english: Central Park at night ain't got nothin' on me!
rows.turkish: Geceleri Central Park bana vız gelir tırıs gider!

rows.english: And I call it necessary. But I didn't expect us to agree on much.
rows.turkish: Ben de buna “gerekli” diyorum. Ama bu kadar çok konuda anlaşacağımızı beklemiyordum.

rows.english: Think twice next time.
rows.turkish: Bir dahaki sefere iki kere düşün.

rows.english: Stick with me. I know every alley in this city.
rows.turkish: Yanımdan ayrılma. Bu şehrin her bir ara sokağını iyi bilirim.

rows.english: Another one gone dark.
Squirrel Girl! Help her, Tandy!
rows.turkish: Sincap Kız! Ona yardım et Tandy!

rows.english: We got a party goin' on here? Glad I wore my fancy cloak…
rows.turkish: Buralarda partiliyor muyuz? İyi ki şık pelerinimi giymişim…

rows.english: Yo, you need healing, We're right here.
With eight legs, a spider better be able to play some music.
rows.turkish: Sekiz bacaklı olduklarına göre örümcekler bir zahmet iyi müzik çalsın.

rows.english: Drown in the abyss!
It's worse than the Darkforce Dimension up in here…
rows.turkish: Burası Darkforce Boyutu'ndan bile daha kötü...

rows.english: We got a shield, Tandy.
Everybody on me!
Special delivery, Wakanda style…
I could use a boost.
Thanks for the offer, bro, but Tandy and me, we locked in.
rows.turkish: Teklifin için sağ ol bro ama Tandy’yle ikimiz hedefe kilitlendik.

rows.english: Just your ordinary beatdown, is all.
Venom belongs to the Darkforce now.
I don't think we should keep the king waiting, do you?
rows.turkish: Bence kralı bekletmemeliyiz. Siz ne dersiniz?

rows.english: Careful, Ty.
This is our objective, right here.
They got a sniper!
Spider-Zero's got places to go! Come on!
rows.turkish: Spider-Zero'nun gideceği yerler var! Haydi ama!

rows.english: Somethin' don't feel right about this place…
rows.turkish: Bu yerle ilgili bir şey doğru gelmiyor...

rows.english: The tree is withering, come on!
Hold tight. See it through.
Gotta say, I'm not a big fan of this whole "Eternal Night" thing…
rows.turkish: Bir şey diyeyim mi? Şu "Ebedî Gece" olayına bayılmadım.

rows.english: Scrapped the amplifier.
That took the edge off, thanks.
This is the spot. Let's keep it.
Naw.
Nah am good, 'your majesty'. Didn't need ya when we were cleaning the streets, won't need ya now.
rows.turkish: İyiyim majesteleri. Sokakları temizlerken sana ihtiyacımız yoktu, şimdi de sana olmayacak.

rows.english: We got something in common, I think.
Come on, the Weaver's waiting!
Can't keep the Weaver waiting. Let's go.
It's not easy, holding the Darkforce in check.
rows.turkish: Karanlık Güç'ü zapt etmek kolay iş değil.

rows.english: Shoot, if it was easy anybody could do it.
The darkness is eroding my wound. I need a doctor!
rows.turkish: Karanlık, yaralarımı aşındırıyor. Doktora ihtiyacım var!

rows.english: It will! I mean —
Too easy to get hurt.
The cloak isn't the power, I got my stuff through some…  Nevermind. Long story.
rows.turkish: Pelerin güç değil; ben bu işi birilerinden… Neyse. Uzun hikâye.

rows.english: Anyone else a little nervous about teamin' up with an angry dinosaur?
rows.turkish: Başka biri de kızgın bir dinozorla takım olmaktan biraz geriliyor mu?

rows.english: We got an appointment with a dragon. Let's roll.
rows.turkish: Bir ejderhayla randevumuz var. Haydi gidelim.

rows.english: It's dark out here. But I can guide you through.
rows.turkish: Burası kapkaranlık olsa da sana yolu gösterebilirim.

rows.english: Vehicle's gotta stop.
Thanks. Almost went dark there.
I'm not looking for a new partner, golden boy. Go sparkle somewhere else.
rows.turkish: Kendime yeni partner aramıyorum altın çocuk. Git başka yerde parılda.

rows.english: Thanks!
Is it me, Tandy, or are we way outta our league here…?
rows.turkish: Bu sadece benim fikrim mi, Tandy, yoksa burada tamamen boyumuzu aşıyor muyuz...?

rows.english: Somebody needs to make the Dooms pay for what they've done.
That's a handful.
Help a brother out.
What's up?
Gonna have to speed it up, little guy!
Really? You do? Cool.
Blade, my brotha, nothing stops you.
rows.turkish: Blade, kardeşim… seni hiçbir şey durduramaz.

rows.english: Let's see how all these little spiders like the Darkforce.
rows.turkish: Bakalım bu minik örümcekler Karanlık Güç'e ne diyecek?

rows.english: How does he make himself into a turret?
Funny. Dagger said the same thing about me…
rows.turkish: Komik. Dagger benim hakkımda da aynı şeyi söylemişti…

rows.english: I survived on the streets. Not lettin' the park do me in!
rows.turkish: Sokaklarda hayata tutunmayı başardım. Park beni kesmez!

rows.english: You walk in darkness, Blade. I am darkness.
Yeah, about that, doc, I think I'll hang on to it for now. At least til my hood's vampire-free.
rows.turkish: Evet doktor, sanırım şimdi sıkıca sarılacağım bu bahsettiğin yönteme. En azından başım vampirlerden kurtuluncaya kadar.

rows.english: Five? Must be somebody else's turn.
Amplifier's gone.
Terror makes you vulnerable.
You ever get scared that the bad side of you is going to win?
rows.turkish: Hiç kötü tarafının galip geleceğinden korktun mu?

rows.english: Need to put the brakes on that vehicle.
We both know what it's like to be consumed by the same thing that makes us different. Gives us power. I don't always know what to do with that.
rows.turkish: İkimiz de bizi farklı kılan ve güç veren şeyin bizi tüketmesinin nasıl bir his olduğunu biliyoruz. Bazen bununla nasıl başa çıkacağımı bilemiyorum.

rows.english: I wrecked Punisher's turret.
Hell no! Ain't no way this cosmic freak is lockin' me up!
rows.turkish: Asla! Bu kozmik ucubenin beni kilitlemesine imkân yok!

rows.english: Stick to the shadows so the Collector don't spot us.
rows.turkish: Koleksiyoncu bizi fark etmesin diye gölgelere yapış.

rows.english: Portal! Strange tracked us!
Rocket's beacon is scrap.
How's it going?
Ooh, the Darkforce likes this…
Thanks for trusting us, Captain.
rows.turkish: Bize güvendiğin için teşekkür ederiz Kaptan.

rows.english: This whole place looks ready to come down.
Nope.
Chaos serves you well, Deadpool.
Rocked Rocket's beacon.
I'm a team player.
Co-op time!
I've seen scarier things before, Namor.
rows.turkish: Daha önce daha korkunç şeyler gördüğüm oldu Namor.

rows.english: So much dark, can't recover.
That was the light I needed.
I wonder how chronovium plays with the Darkforce…
rows.turkish: Acaba kronovyum, Karanlık Güç’e nasıl tepki verir?..

rows.english: I got what you need.
I dunno, man. The Maggia were doing something extra crazy when it came to Tandy and me.
rows.turkish: Bilmiyorum dostum. Maggia, Tandy ve ben söz konusu olunca fazladan manyakça bir şeyler yapıyordu.

rows.english: Whoops.
If I didn't have Tandy, the Darkforce would have taken me a long time ago.
rows.turkish: Tandy olmasaydı Karanlık Güç beni çoktan ele geçirmişti.

rows.english: We're gonna miss you, big fella.
This city does not hide its darkness well.
rows.turkish: Bu şehir karanlığını pek iyi saklayamıyor.

rows.english: Man, it would be sweet to shoot fire.
rows.turkish: Ah adamım, ateş saçsaydın ne hoş olurdu.

rows.english: Not a big fan of folks kidnapping innocents. Let's set 'em free!
rows.turkish: Masumları kaçıranlardan pek hoşlanmam. Hadi onları serbest bırakalım!

rows.english: This sure as hell ain't the New York I remember...
rows.turkish: Benim hatırladığım New York böyle değildi, orası kesin…

rows.english: Those squids sure aren't pretty.
Draw back! Hold your horses!
A place of captivity. But I can always escape to the void.
rows.turkish: Tutsaklığın mekânı. Ama her zaman boşluğa kaçabilirim.

rows.english: Cruising through Tokyo with Spider-Zero.
Rise up, fight back!
You got it.
Bout to unleash Darkforce terror.
We can make a stand right here.
The beacon is down!
This'll make it easy.
Our wheels. Let's move em!
rows.turkish: Araç bizim araç. Haydi yola çıkalım!

rows.english: I admired you, Cap. The version of you that I knew, I mean.
rows.turkish: Sana hayrandım Kaptan. Yani tanıdığım versiyonuna.

rows.english: The coast is clear… of squids, at least…
rows.turkish: Tehlike geçti… En azından kalamar tehlikesi…

rows.english: Darkforce always gets em.
Gotta ice 'em out!
Rise up, fight back!
Spider nest is all cleared.
Straight to the castle. No more playin' tourist!
You're not listenin'. There's a darkness here. And it's growin' by the minute…
rows.turkish: Dinlemiyorsun. Burada bir karanlık var. Ve her dakika büyüyor...

rows.english: Ain't too good.
News flash: Robot spiders don't like the Darkforce.
rows.turkish: Herkese duyurulur: Robot örümcekler Karanlık Güç'ten hoşlanmadı.

rows.english: Moon Knight left an ankh here.
rows.turkish: Moon Knight buraya yaşam çarmıhı bırakmış.

rows.english: Strange popped a portal here!
Helping from the shadows.
Light and dark need each other to exist.
rows.turkish: Aydınlık ve karanlık, var olabilmek için birbirlerine ihtiyaç duyar.

rows.english: Does he ever run out of these ankhs?
rows.turkish: Şu yaşam çarmıhları hiç mi bitmiyor?

rows.english: This is black magic blotting out the sun, man. It's not something I can just 'port away.
rows.turkish: Kara büyüyle güneşi karartmışlar be dostum. Öylece ışınlayarak çözebileceğim bir şey değil.

rows.english: Doesn't this buggy have another gear?
rows.turkish: Şu aracın başka hızı yok mu?

rows.english: Darkness swallows you.
Be stronger!
The Darkforce feeds…
I get a little carried away sometimes.
Good as new.
I ain't afraid, but I ain't dumb, either. We're outnumbered.
rows.turkish: Korkak değilim ama aptal da değilim. Sayıca üstünler.

rows.english: Punisher's gone turret mode!
All wrapped up.
Here comes the living legend!
Suffer in the darkness!
Even diamonds crack in the void.
Watch yourself around here.
Big mistake messing with the Darkforce.
rows.turkish: Karanlık Güç’e bulaşmakla büyük hata ettin.

rows.english: Yeah.
This spot doesn't feel right.
Ruby red just faded to black…
rows.turkish: Yakut kırmızısı az önce siyaha döndü…

rows.english: Damn, what a way to go.
rows.turkish: Vay be, bu ne biçim bir sonmuş.

rows.english: I like the dark, but this is too much!
rows.turkish: Karanlığı severim ama bu kadarı fazla!

rows.english: Shouldn't have come at me.
We gotta move it, y'all! Save the web!
Enemy's got the block! Get 'em!
Triple time.
Gambit. You seem really eager to jump into battle, as always.
rows.turkish: GAMBIT. Her zamanki gibi savaşa atılmak için fazlasıyla heveslisin.

rows.english: One octopus attack, over.
Get in here, y'all.
Gotta finish em now or never.
rows.turkish: Ya şimdi işlerini bitireceğiz ya da asla.

rows.english: Taking five.
Seen enough kids in cages to last me a lifetime.
rows.turkish: Hayatım boyunca yeterince kafeste çocuk gördüm.

rows.english: Ankh, be careful!
Darkness reigns!
Nothing's getting amplified here.
Ready to behold our True power?
rows.turkish: Gerçek gücümüze şahit olmaya hazır mısınız?

rows.english: The darkness…h-h-help.
Maintain control of the target area.
They definitely nailed the villain's lair aesthetic.
Spider-Man, hey! I've been meaning to ask you, we should form some kind of group —
rows.turkish: Örümcek Adam merhaba! Sana bir tür grup kursak mı diye soracaktım.

rows.english: Struck down by a sista! Love to see it!
Appreciate the boost.
Wow, can you believe a place like this exists?
rows.turkish: Vay canına, böyle bir yerin var olduğuna inanabiliyor musun?

rows.english: Got out my can opener. Punisher's out.
Push on! Don't get trapped in this madhouse!
rows.turkish: Devam edin! Bu tımarhanede kapana kısılmayın!

rows.english: These are my streets. We got this.
rows.turkish: Buralar benim mahallem. Bu iş bizde.

rows.english: I love this place, but we need to move through it a little faster.
rows.turkish: Buraya bayılıyorum ama birazcık daha hızlı ilerlemeliyiz.

rows.english: I'm a walking space between dimensions, more or less.
rows.turkish: Az çok boyutlar arasındaki boşluğun ayaklı hâliyim.

rows.english: Things are about to get a lot darker if we don't move.
rows.turkish: Harekete geçmezsek her şey çok daha kararacak.

rows.english: Let's get this core where it's goin'! Now!
rows.turkish: Bu çekirdeği gideceği yere götürelim! Hemen!

rows.english: Appreciate you.
I couldn't be better. I'll show them what I can do.
rows.turkish: Daha iyi olamazdım. Onlara neler yapabileceğimi göstereceğim.

rows.english: Watch for the enemy here.
Sniper's out.
Did we just get…stronger?
rows.turkish: Az önce daha güçlü mü olduk biz?

rows.english: You shouldn't have started something with me.
Light's out.
We got you, Spider-Zero. Let's ride.
rows.turkish: Bu iş bizde Spider-Zero. Haydi yola devam.

rows.english: Mutants are like family to us. We protect our own.
rows.turkish: Mutantlar bizim ailemiz sayılır. Birbirimize sahip çıkarız.

rows.english: That's too many to fight.
I didn't mean to do it all myself.
Hell no! They gotta get through me first!
rows.turkish: Hayatta olmaz! Önce beni geçmeleri gerekecek!

rows.english: Get this vehicle home.
Us too. Now let's show them how we win this thing in style.
rows.turkish: Biz de. Şimdi gel de bunu nasıl şık bir şekilde kazandığımızı onlara gösterelim.

rows.english: They're coming up ahead.
Prison break sounds like a nice distraction…
rows.turkish: Hapishaneden kaçış kulağa iyi bir oyalama gibi geliyor…

rows.english: Before we put all these worlds back together, I want to see some places I'll never see again.
rows.turkish: Tüm bu dünyaları bir araya getirmeden önce, bir daha asla görmeyeceğim yerleri görmek istiyorum.

rows.english: No way we let the X-Men go down like this!
Yeah, I've guided plenty of folks safely through the dark myself.
rows.turkish: Evet, nicesine karanlıkta bizzat yol gösterdim.

rows.english: Even your wards couldn't stop the dark, Strange!
rows.turkish: Karanlığı senin tılsımların bile durduramadı, Strange!

rows.english: Us against the world!
A place of conflict. Light versus dark.
Not very good…but I'm holding up.
rows.turkish: Pek iyi değilim ama dayanmaya çalışıyorum.

rows.english: Everybody, come here!
No one deserves to be caged up like this. Not ever.
rows.turkish: Hiç kimse böyle bir kafese kapatılmayı hak etmez. Asla.

rows.english: That's it for the spider nest.
Under the circumstances, that will do.
You fight me, you fight the Darkforce too.
rows.turkish: Bana bulaşan Karanlık Güç’e de bulaşmış demektir.

rows.english: It's a good thing I'm not afraid of the dark…
Fight it, Ty!
Time to put up or shut up.
rows.turkish: Ya direneceğiz ya da boyun eğeceğiz.

rows.english: Darkforce doesn't write happy endings.
rows.turkish: Karanlık Güç varken mutlu son olmaz.

rows.english: Sniper didn't see me coming.
Taste MY pain.
Bring the hammer down here.
I'll take three, until four comes along.
Hit this spot hard.
Trust me, lady, you don't want to find out…
That's the Darkforce. Strong, and greedy too.
rows.turkish: İşte Karanlık Güç böyledir. Hem güçlü hem de açgözlü.

rows.english: How do you like that, Khonshu?
Live in fear!
We can't all treat life like one big game of cards. Darkforce does not play.
rows.turkish: Hepimiz hayatı koca bir iskambil oyunu gibi yaşayamayız. Darkforce oyun oynamaz.

rows.english: We're partners. In more ways than one. And wait, I thought the X-Men loved jumpsuits.
rows.turkish: Biz ortağız. Birden fazla anlamda. Bir dakika, X-Men’in taytları sevdiğini sanıyordum.

rows.english: I'm doing good.
Let's get this statue to T'Challa. You with me?
rows.turkish: Bu heykeli T'Challa'ya ulaştıralım. Yanımda mısın?

rows.english: Score one for Ty!
We're not getting there fast enough!
Don't know what you just said, little buddy, but I got a feelin' we're ridin' the same wave.
rows.turkish: Ne dediğini bilmiyorum, küçük dostum, ama hissediyorum ki aynı dalgada sürükleniyoruz.

rows.english: Getting the darkforce ready!
Says the woman dripped out with more ice than Bobby Drake…
rows.turkish: Bobby Drake’ten bile daha buz kesmiş kadın diyor bunu…

rows.english: They've been 'ere long enough!
I've got Dagger to keep me in line.
Co-op time!
No more squids? Good.
The sniper has gone dark.
Tandy, h-h-help!
We're gonna need your help.
It's a cloak. And it ain't the source of my powers. It just helps me channel them.
rows.turkish: Bu bir pelerin. Gücümün kaynağı da değil. Sadece gücümü kullanmama yardımcı oluyor.

rows.english: Yeah, just let a crazy scientist experiment on you…
rows.turkish: Evet, bırakalım da çılgın bir bilim insanı üzerimizde deney yapsın…

rows.english: Come on! I am not about to piss off a dragon!
rows.turkish: Hadi ama! Bir ejderhayı kızdırmaya hiç niyetim yok!

rows.english: I guess a turret is Punisher's final form.
rows.turkish: Demek ki Punisher'ın en güçlü hâli taretmiş.

rows.english: Don't worry 'bout my fit, Frost. We've got more important things to do.
rows.turkish: Sen kılığımı dert etme Frost. Daha önemli meselelerimiz var.

rows.english: What?
Portal! Who's coming through?
I've worn the X before. Guess it's time to prove why!
rows.turkish: Daha önce ben de X logosunu takmıştım. Şimdi kendimi kanıtlama zamanı!

rows.english: Good. Stay near this creature!
Deep freeze!
Ran the table. Sweet.
Through the veil!
